Grant_Focus: Development research, climate adaptation, inclusive economies
Why_This_Funder: Funds Southern-led development research including climate adaptation and financial inclusion; a natural home for the experiment-design and impact-measurement workstream. Programs and open calls to be researched.
Funds and supports impact evaluations directly aligned with the causal-measurement methodology; potential match for the experiment-design deliverable. Verify current thematic windows.
Funds randomized evaluations at exactly the climate-and-poverty intersection this proposal targets; J-PAL is also the standing verification-partner candidate (PT-05). Confirm eligibility and cycle.

Grant_Focus: Financial markets, green finance, capital-market development
Why_This_Funder: Backs financial-market and green-finance development in Africa, including securitization and capital-market deepening; relevant to both the research and the structuring thesis. Research active facilities.

Grant_Focus: Livelihoods, financial inclusion, youth and women's economic opportunity
Why_This_Funder: Large Africa-focused funder of financial inclusion and livelihoods; potential support for pilot origination and inclusion outcomes. Confirm research vs programme funding fit.
Funds the climate-plus-livelihoods intersection, including renewable energy and smallholder agriculture; possible fit for energy-access and climate-resilience experiments. Research grant mechanism.
Backs early-stage energy-access enterprises and models; relevant to the clean-energy financing experiments (EXP-02, EXP-08). Confirm whether it funds research or only ventures.

Grant_Focus: Climate adaptation and mitigation, incl. private-sector facility
Why_This_Funder: Largest dedicated climate fund; more project- than research-oriented, but its readiness and private-sector windows may support blended-structure design. Requires an accredited entity - research the access route.
History of funding innovative and blended finance at the climate-poverty intersection; potential design/convening support. Research current initiatives and entry point.
French DFI group active across Africa and MENA with both research and blended-finance windows; relevant to structuring as well as study funding. Identify the research vs investment desk.

Grant_Focus: Policy-relevant applied research with local partners; growth, firms, finance
Why_This_Funder: The most solo-compatible research funder in the pipeline: small, fast-turnaround grants run through country offices, aimed at policy-relevant work done with local partners, and not requiring the applicant to be a tenured principal investigator the way a large trial grant does. Route for the OQ-21 Form 2 collaboration - an embedded evaluation alongside a live facility with an academic partner as PI. Tracked as a partner at PT-22. Calls, deadlines and typical grant size still to be researched.

Grant_Focus: Staged funding for innovations with evidence of impact, from pilot to scale
Why_This_Funder: Funds innovations in stages against evidence, which fits a practice whose first deliverables are a field-tested origination standard and a costed cost curve rather than a product with users. Relevant to the solo track because it funds the evidence-building stage directly instead of requiring a scaled operation first. Calls, instruments and eligibility still to be researched - in particular whether an advisory practice rather than an implementer is eligible.
